runs.title: pii-guard llm (muse-glimmer, reasoning_strength low) on smoke
runs.hardware: Modal, 1x NVIDIA H100 80 GB, vLLM (vllm/vllm-openai:muse-glimmer), bf16

cost.note: About one H100-hour, about $4, for the three zero-shot runs together, including the cold start (model download and torch.compile).

notes: Zero-shot (no fine-tuning). reasoning_strength was passed as chat_template_kwargs by a patched LlmDetector payload (Glimmer ignores reasoning_effort); the detector had no setting for it yet.
Decode about 44 tokens/s; reasoning is almost all of the latency.
